description: This file contains build definitions and macros for building firmware images for various embedded devices, specifically for the iMX platform. It defines build procedures, device-specific configurations, and image creation processes.

methods.name: Build/boot-overlay
methods.description: Builds a bootable overlay image by copying kernel, device trees, and creating a boot script and ubifs image.

methods.name: Build/bootfs.tar.gz
methods.description: Creates a tar.gz archive of the boot filesystem.

methods.name: Build/recovery-scr
methods.description: Builds a recovery boot script image.

methods.name: Build/apalis-emmc
methods.description: Prepares combined images for the Apalis device.

methods.name: Build/ventana-img
methods.description: Builds an image specific to the Ventana device, including copying kernel, device trees, generating images.
